name: The Witch's Disciples
storyline: After being rescued by a beautiful witch named Mireille, Kyle is lovestruck and decides to become her pupil and learn the ways of magic. He proves to have a surprising talent for it, and combined with his diligent study, he becomes a better and better mage by the day, unlike Mireille's other trouble-making pupil, Glenn. One day, Glenn gets into an accident, leaving it up to Kyle to set out with Mireille and prove himself a capable mage by helping make the medicine needed to heal Glenn. Finally, the chance to show off his growth and win Mireille's affection has arrived!
summary: After being rescued by a beautiful witch named Mireille, Kyle is lovestruck and decides to become her pupil and learn the ways of magic. Set out for adventure as Kyle with the witch Mireille and go questing in dungeons in this lightweight RPG! Fight monsters, gain experience, learn spells, and use magic to conquer bosses.
